summary: Executed requested P0 verification for Supplier Documents NDA/agreement tranche: targeted pytest command, live auth boundaries, controlled live R2 lifecycle, controlled Mongo acceptance persistence + completion updates, and frontend smoke for admin/supplier routes.

integration_issues.issue: Supplier route URL loads but a Premium Module gate is rendered in the visible content area, preventing practical review of assigned agreements from UI in this account context.

action_items: Investigate supplier portal Premium Module gate overlap/feature-flag behavior on /supplier-assessment/documents/review so suppliers can practically view assigned agreement versions in UI.
Keep current immutable acceptance behavior (document_version_id persisted, repeat acceptance returns original record) as canonical baseline.
critical_code_review_comments: Verified document API route surface has no PUT/DELETE mutation methods for /documents endpoints (GET/POST only).
No code changes detected in Training or calc_engine paths during this verification run.
Version lineage behavior validated: one lineage increments 1→2→3 while a separate lineage starts at 1.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary uniquely-prefixed Mongo records and disposable R2 objects only for controlled tests; all deleted in finally blocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Requested command result: 20 passed, 1 warning in 3.82s (includes newly added live verification file). Live auth boundaries passed (admin list 200, admin supplier-only 403, supplier admin-list 403, supplier my-documents 200/404-safe). Controlled R2 test used org_facility bucket organization-facility-data-dev with unique prefix supplier-assessment/verification/<uuid>, verified upload/get/presigned URL/delete, and confirmed object absence after delete. Controlled persistence test inserted temporary program+relationships+version+requirement records, accepted same version from two suppliers, repeat acceptance immutable; completion updated via supplier_service._update_completion_status. Exact cleanup outcome observed: {'acceptances': 2, 'requirements': 1, 'versions': 1, 'relationships': 2, 'programs': 1}.
rca of the issue: Supplier review route appears to mount but visible page area is occupied by a Premium Module gate for the tested supplier account context. This is likely feature/entitlement gating in layout or route-level wrappers rather than SupplierDocuments component fetch failure, because supplier-documents testid is still present while premium content is rendered. Mitigation: review module entitlement checks for supplier-assessment/documents/review and ensure supplier document review remains accessible for intended supplier users.
